title: Population-Level Profiling of DSM-5 Depressive Symptom Language Among Twitter Users With Self-Reported ADHD or ASD: Exploratory Study Using Natural Language Processing and Statistical Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2607.05626v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Depression frequently co-occurs with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and autism spectrum disorder (ASD), but how depressive symptoms are expressed by people with these conditions is underexplored. We examined whether Twitter users self-reporting ADHD or ASD differ in language related to the nine DSM-5 depressive symptoms. We analysed 1,282,437 tweets (2020-2021) from 792 users. Tweets were screened for depressive relevance by a zero-shot classifier combined with a locally run large language model (Qwen3-8B) and classified into the nine symptoms by MentalRoBERTa fine-tuned on the ReDSM5 corpus. The pipeline was tuned on two stratified samples of 500 tweets and internally validated against human-adjudicated labels on 150 of these tweets. translated_title: 自述患有多动症（ADHD）或自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的Twitter用户中DSM-5抑郁症状语言的群体水平画像：一项使用自然语言处理与统计分析的探索性研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.05626v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：抑郁症常与注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）和自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）共病，但患有这些疾病的人群如何表达抑郁症状尚缺乏研究。我们考察了自述患有ADHD或ASD的Twitter用户在与DSM-5九项抑郁症状相关的语言表达上是否存在差异。我们分析了792名用户的1,282,437条推文（2020-2021年）。推文首先由零样本分类器结合本地运行的大语言模型（Qwen3-8B）筛选抑郁相关性，再由在ReDSM5语料库上微调的MentalRoBERTa分类到九种症状类别中。该流程在两个各含500条推文的分层样本上进行调优，并针对其中150条推文的人工判定标签进行了内部验证。用户层面的症状画像（582名用户）通过L1惩罚逻辑回归、嵌套交叉验证、自助法稳定性分析、逐症状效应量以及共现分析进行比较。
tldr: 该研究构建了零样本分类器结合本地大语言模型（Qwen3-8B）与经ReDSM5微调的MentalRoBERTa的自然语言处理流程，对自述ADHD或ASD的792名Twitter用户的百万余条推文进行DSM-5九项抑郁症状的自动分类与统计建模，从而在群体水平揭示了两组神经发育障碍人群抑郁症状语言表达的差异。
en_tdlr: This study builds an NLP pipeline combining a zero-shot classifier with a locally run large language model (Qwen3-8B) and MentalRoBERTa fine-tuned on ReDSM5 to automatically classify DSM-5 depressive symptom language across over one million tweets from Twitter users self-reporting ADHD or ASD, revealing population-level differences in how the two groups express depressive symptoms.
